lane:
قولنج

قُوْلَنْجٌ , (Msb, * K,) with fet-h to the ل, (Msb,) and sometimes قَوْلِنْجٌ, with kesr to the ل, or thus and قُولِنْجٌ, i. e. with kesr to the ل and with fet-h and damm to the ق, (K,) a foreign word, (TA,) [from the Greek κωλικὸσ The _colic;_] _a certain painful intestinal disease, in which the egress of the feces and wind is attended with difficulty;_ (K;) _a violent griping in the intestine called the colon._ (Msb.)

entries.text: القولنج، وقد تكسر لامه، أو هو مكسور اللام، ويفتح القاف ويضم: مرض معوي مؤلم، يعسر معه خروج الثفل والريح.
